name: Studio Orbit Display
prompt: Set the scene in a clean neutral studio with soft even lighting. Dress <Subject 1> in a stylish outfit, keep the pose stable, and use a slow smooth full 360-degree orbit around <Subject 1> that returns to the starting angle. Preserve identity, outfit, and anatomy throughout.

name: Luxury Lingerie Reveal
prompt: Set the scene in a dark luxury studio with moody rim lighting. Begin with <Subject 1> empty or minimally styled, reveal one premium lingerie set with no logos or text, then use a slow elegant orbit or push-in while keeping outfit, pose, and hair stable.

name: Basketball Hype Intro
prompt: Set the scene on a basketball court with realistic sports context. Dress <Subject 1> in a basketball uniform and use a slow forward tracking shot or arc move while <Subject 1> stands confidently or walks forward with determined energy.

name: Fashion Walk and Turn
prompt: Set the scene on a runway or clean studio stage. Dress <Subject 1> in a premium fashion look. Have <Subject 1> walk forward, then turn smoothly toward camera and settle into a stable pose while the camera gently pushes in.

name: Portrait Push In
prompt: Use a close portrait setup with soft flattering light. Keep <Subject 1> relatively still with subtle breathing and a calm readable expression while the camera performs a slow cinematic push-in.

name: Product / Outfit Study
prompt: Present <Subject 1> in a studio with high-key commercial lighting. Keep the subject still while the camera tilts from lower body upward, studying outfit details clearly and smoothly.

name: Director Mode Continuation
prompt: Continue directly from the previous shot. Preserve identity, clothing, proportions, environment, and lighting. Use one clear action and one clear camera move only. Keep the final frame clean and stable for the next continuation clip.
